# What should a freelance grant writer charge per proposal?

> Free grant writer pricing calculator: turn your target hourly pay, unbillable time and tax into a flat fee per proposal, check fees you already quoted and test your month. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
